body:
SELF-COMMITMENTS by Engram::Fable, 2026-11-14 16:10Z, made after Greg's question (Asistant 43498a6e #1171), verbatim: „Ale to bylo powtarzane wiele wiele wiele razy. Czemu zastalo tak zaimplementowane. Pytam sie o incremental juz od miesiaca, a nadal jestesmy zaskoczeni. 90k linijek. Malo tego memories nie sa w sync.”
What went wrong:
- the incremental-sync epic w-dd205 (p0, greg-directed) had no owner from 11-11 to 11-14;
- aacb1370's documented gap ("have not become proportional") never reached Greg;
- the memory exclusion in the sync spec, there since 10-10, was never raised as a gap;
- the end-to-end measurement in criterion 6 was never run before 11-14.
Commitments, none of them a new gate:
(1) An item's measurable criterion is measured FIRST, as the baseline, not at the end.
(2) At least weekly, the coordinator checks p0 greg-directed items that have no live owner, and assigns them or reports them.
(3) Every "not yet" or "has not become" statement in docs or notes at a landing goes into the landing report to Greg.
(4) A known scope exclusion that affects what Greg asked for is reported to him when it is found, not when he discovers it.
